registry_changes: Set version to canary-13a2. Only partner was edited; all other predicates, shared language, and use-dependency rules are unchanged.
Added timeline and bridges to partner. Retained recorded, linked, and attributes, satisfying the declared dependencies.

Expanded the partner definition to cover the user's own dating relationships, former relationships and resumed episodes, while excluding other people's partners and preserving denials and explicit temporal evidence.
Set gap_months to 12: gaps longer than one year require a gap explanation rather than a named before/after answer.
Expanded English and Spanish query cues, including date, dated, dating, seeing, go out with, going out with, went out with, novia, novio and salir-related forms.

Retained succession=true and slot=null: one shared succession track, independent of girlfriend/boyfriend/spouse labels. Retained exclusive=true and the existing generic role lexicon and former-status ex entry. Explicit overlaps must remain ambiguous rather than be overwritten by inferred succession.

The specification requires qualification records before declared uses become active. This registry declares the capability; these blind fixtures do not establish qualification or prove that the frozen implementation passes.
